title: Jeffrey Yelton v. Westminster Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC declared the complaint no longer in order after receiving documentation that Yelton had joined the Presbytery of the Alleghenies of the Reformed Presbyterian Church of North America.
first_summary: The SJC declared Yelton’s complaint against Westminster Presbytery no longer in order because documentation showed that he had joined another denomination’s presbytery. It made no merits determination.
